metadata.citation: HARMAN/ILFORD, MULTIGRADE FB CLASSIC Technical Information, Oct 2013, page 2 (filter 2 / grade 2 curve).
metadata.datasource: https://www.freestylephoto.com/static/pdf/pages/product_pdfs/ilford/FS_MGFB_CLASSIC_TI_1013.pdf; SHA256 b4fe0ea11aad13ef4210c59bb42f49bc121ea213cf1a9ee96faf35832473dd43; source record e95780b4a417fa97aef9efeef2b1c8fe1dbef5907354559ce2c6d3784a762836. Glossy 1K; filter 2 / grade 2; MULTIGRADE 1+9; 2 min at 20 C. PDF vector centerline; plotting coordinates, not measured samples. Exposure origin is the paper-white-relative 18% reflectance convention at source logE 0.802507923762; the plotted x-axis is not calibrated to absolute lux-seconds and ISO P230 is not used as the origin. Flat 0.0 log-sensitivity is a placeholder: page 1 has no numeric ordinate and no grade-specific curve. No measured base spectrum, Dmax, batch, fluorescence, BRDF or scanner match. One grade only; no 00-5 variable-contrast prediction.
